source: OpenStreetMap contributors; BBBike.org Iraq PBF extract
deduplication: Unique OSM objects keyed by @type + @id across clipped amenities and buildings layers; repeated LineString/Polygon representations of the same closed way counted once.

geometry_notes.duplicate_geometry_note: Closed OSM ways can appear as both LineString and Polygon in the amenities export; the audit deduplicates by OSM object identity.

limitations: Counts describe the downloaded OSM snapshot only, not a complete census of all real-world Baghdad places of worship.
Some place_of_worship objects have no religion tag and are intentionally kept in an unspecified category.
Regional 1 km geometry is exterior-only; it does not prove interiors, collision, signage, or architectural fidelity.
The 200 m detailed pack and regional overview must be validated independently.
